caption: Five uniquely resolved high/moderate A/B pairs in the 50-genome screen. Three flanking annotated CDS on either side are displayed in original order and strand, using coordinates relative to the A-family CDS start and a shared scale. D29 has one intervening CDS; the other pairs overlap by one nucleotide. Colors denote reference-supported categories, with the pair confidence shown per row; matching category colors do not imply identical sequences, independent ancestry or demonstrated native activity.
